rules.title: WhatsApp service rules
rules.description: The Maia reads this text before every message on your personal WhatsApp. It applies from the next message.
rules.waitHelp: Time she waits for you to answer first.
rules.capture: Record context and suggest demands, tasks and notes
rules.captureHelp: After each contact message. You confirm each suggestion.

paused.title: Paused conversations
paused.description: You answered: the Maia stays quiet in these conversations for 2 h.

tasks.title: Conversations opened by the Maia
tasks.description: Messages she sent at your request, with a goal.

agentTasks.description: Decide on tasks and incubations. Approval releases work to the queue; dependencies and available capacity still govern execution.
agentTasks.uncertainHint: Reconcile the previous execution outcome before authorizing another attempt.
agentTasks.approvalHint: This work requires approval of its current content. Later changes require a new decision.
agentTasks.approveHint: You are authorizing the current content. Work enters the queue and waits for completed dependencies and available capacity.
agentTasks.archiveHint: Archiving preserves history and does not mean the work is completed or approved.
agentTasks.bulkHint: Each record will be checked again. Changed or running items will be rejected individually.
agentTasks.restoreHint: Restoring preserves history and clears the schedule. Execution requires a new approval.
agentTasks.authorizeRetryHint: Authorization renews the limit without starting the task. Check the evidence, then explicitly approve queueing.

blocked.execution_has_outcome: Reconcile or review the outcome before release.
blocked.execution_context_missing: Set sender, executor and working directory in Messages before approval.
blocked.no_uncertain_outcome: There is no uncertain outcome to investigate.

agentTasks.investigationHint: Records what was checked. Reconciliation stays pending until you confirm the run is not active.
agentTasks.confirmInactiveHint: Confirm only after checking this run is not running. The failure becomes known, nothing runs, and another attempt still needs authorization.
agentTasks.typeRun: Type the run identifier to confirm:

location.title: Current location
location.description: The weather in the Maia's daily summary uses this GPS location. Only the latest one is kept. Never the VPS's location.
location.none: No location yet. Without one, the forecast uses Rio de Janeiro (RJ).
location.pinHint: You can also send the Maia a location pin on Telegram or WhatsApp.

gpsError.denied: Location permission was denied. Allow it in the browser settings.
gpsError.unavailable: Couldn't get a GPS fix right now.
gpsError.timeout: GPS took too long to answer. Try again.

dailySummary.title: Daily summaries
dailySummary.description: The morning summary the Maia sent, with the location the weather used.
dailySummary.empty: No summary recorded in this period.

groups.loadError: Could not read monitored groups. The registry has not changed.
groups.captureError: Could not read this group's captures.
groups.noCaptures: No captures registered for this group.
groups.empty: No monitored groups registered. Maia can register a monitored group, or you can use the button above.
groups.select: Select a group to see its captures and demand origins.
